latestVersion.changelog:
Janitor AI Image to Video v1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Instantly transforms static images (JPG, PNG, WEBP, GIF up to 200MB) into animated video clips using AI, with no editing software required.
- Supports simple, conversational instructions to generate and edit video clips with motion, text overlays, and audio tracks.
- Cloud-based rendering pipeline delivers 1080p MP4 videos in about 30–90 seconds; all processing is remote with no local installation needed.
- Automatic session and token management, with a free starter quota for new users.
- Provides real-time status updates, credits checking, and easy export/download of finished videos.
